sanity_check.note: The spec's §3 check (recall@10 == db_match_count/304) compares two different quantities and does NOT hold: recall@10 is 'at least one same-db exemplar in the top 10', db_match is 'the majority vote over those 10 picked the right database'. The majority-vote reconstruction above is the check that tests what §3 intended.
